data_output.description: data.py.load and data.py.encode must return train, validation, and test feature matrices in canonical source row order. Feature columns are user_id, video_id, tab, hour, weekday, encoded with separate training-only vocabularies, field-specific explicit unknown indices, and offsets. Train and validation retain long_view labels; test exposes features and row order but no labels.

model_input.description: model.py receives the encoded integer feature matrix with one row per impression and columns user_id, video_id, tab, hour, and weekday. The existing neutral additive BCE model sums the corresponding weights; no interactions or additional inputs are permitted.
